articles.summary: Longtime St. Croix resort will be rebuilt as a 150-key Club Med under a VICI-funded lease, with work starting summer 2026 and reopening targeted for Q4 2027.
articles.title: CLUB MED ADVANCES STRATEGIC NORTH AMERICAN EXPANSION WITH THE REDEVELOPMENT OF CARAMBOLA BEACH RESORT IN ST. CROIX IN PARTNERSHIP WITH VICI PROPERTIES

articles.summary: Redevelopment of St. Croix’s historic Carambola Beach Resort will add 200 jobs as VICI funds upgrades and Club Med plans a Q4 2027 reopening.
articles.title: VICI Properties and Club Med Announce Acquisition and Redevelopment of Carambola Beach Resort in St. Croix

articles.summary: Alberta portfolio joins VICI's PURE master lease as annual rent rises CAD$16.1M. The deal closed alongside PURE's take-private Gamehost acquisition.
articles.title: VICI Properties Inc. Completes Sale-Leaseback of Canadian Portfolio in Connection With Pure Casino Entertainment’s Acquisition of Gamehost

articles.summary: Shareholders receive a $0.45 cash dividend per VICI Properties share for the April–June 2026 quarter, payable July 9 to holders of record on June 18.
articles.title: VICI Properties Inc. Declares Regular Quarterly Dividend

articles.summary: Results land after the July 29 close, then management hosts a July 30 webcast and Q&A. Replay stays on VICI's website for one year.
articles.title: VICI Properties Inc. Announces Release Date for Second Quarter 2026 Results
